Assignment editor

/teach/courses/:courseId/assignments/:assignmentId/edit
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S15

Configure individual or group submission rules, assessment points and publication without altering received work.

WhenClose precedes due
ShowsField errors with exact course-zone comparison

Unassigned targets
WhenGroup mode leaves learners outside groups
ShowsNamed count and assignment exclusion warning
Way outResolve W47 or explicitly adjust targets

WhenPublished version has receipts
ShowsImpact panel; target mode locked for existing work

WhenMembership differs after preview
ShowsStale group-snapshot warning
Way outRefresh and review affected members
Dialogs and drawers (2)
Publish assignment revision
  • Changed instructions/dates, targeted learners/groups and snapshot ID
  • One submission receipt shared by all snapshot members; later joins/withdrawals preserve old work
Return without applying changesPublish reviewed version
Unsaved changes
  • Name the current draft and changed fields; show save destination and whether sample storage is available.
  • Discard restores the last saved draft, never deletes received work or published history.
Keep editingSave draft and return, or explicitly discard changes
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Group submission yields one receipt shown to every authorised snapshot member.
  • Later membership change never rewrites prior receipt ownership.
  • Publication fails when question maxima or rubric totals disagree; old publication remains.
  • Saving an incomplete draft preserves entered fields with draft status; publishing/applying remains blocked until consequential validation passes. Cancel keeps published/received history unchanged.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
  • TA authoring is disabled in initial HTML; listed authoring actions require a separately approved future grant.
